request.scope: account IAM or project IAM where declared; lists floatingips/keypairs and keypair mutations account only
request.identity: immutable account/project scope; exact Resell allocation ID; keypair name plus owner parent; no Neutron ref adoption

path_fields.subnet_id: matching ref.ID, owner parent.ID or request.ProjectID escaped once

request.validation: explicit target project required and must match project view; required spec fields; int32 numeric request fields; license quantity >=1 when present; exact ref kind/account/project/service/generation/endpoint and owner validated before IO; no hidden defaults

response.field_mapping: All schema fields plus pinned SDK-only subnet vlan_id/vtep_ip_address and SSH-key region/regions. Integer precision retained; optional fields preserve absence. Provider injected refs discarded.
response.resource_ref: ID from Resell id (keypair name+user owner); exact endpoint/scope/generation; create extracts all trustworthy IDs before decoding fields; foreign project or duplicate allocation IDs rejected; no name lookup

errors.404: not_found for safe reads; mutation rejection only when documented
errors.transport_loss: unknown_outcome after possible mutation transmission; exact request refs preserved
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and trustworthy provider IDs already extracted
errors.message: fixed SDK message; raw provider messages discarded
errors.foreign_response_id: scope_mismatch; reject before adding foreign identity to Receipt

retry: bounded safe reads; mutation single attempt, never replay

wait.availability: unavailable; provider CRUD binding does not imply a wait contract

recovery.availability: unavailable for root handle; exact Get is observational and does not prove authorship of unknown mutation

timeout: CallTimeout; CollectionTimeout shared across list pages

sdk_source.disposition: published SDK extends pinned API schema; independently confirmed response shapes, optional quantity and subnet fields are supported explicitly
